leads.candidate: Opgaande bruine beuk bij Klein Begijnhof Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-Ter-Hoye (register object 131363)
leads.reason: Access uncertain, not confirmed private. Register text: the garden this beech stands in was the walled ('ommuurde') private garden of the grootjuffer (the beguinage's directress), and is 'nu ingericht als park voor de begijnhofbewoners' (now laid out as a park FOR THE BEGUINAGE RESIDENTS), distinct from the beguinage's main courtyard which nl.wikipedia confirms remains a public tourist attraction ('blijft het Klein Begijnhof een toeristische trekpleister'). Two attempts to find a source confirming whether visitors may enter this specific garden (as opposed to the main courtyard) returned nothing usable in the time available. Do not ship until this is resolved: either confirm the garden is open to visitors, or confirm it is resident-only and block it.

Worth a look in a later pass if the city needs to grow past six; not a rejection on the merits, just not reached.
